mysteries.title: The Annunciation
mysteries.description: The Angel Gabriel announces to Mary that she will bear the Son of God
mysteries.scripture_text: 'Hail, full of grace, the Lord is with you!' (Luke 1:28)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for humility and acceptance of God's will in our lives.

mysteries.title: The Visitation
mysteries.description: Mary visits her cousin Elizabeth
mysteries.scripture_text: 'Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!' (Luke 1:42)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for charity and service to others, especially those in need.

mysteries.title: The Nativity
mysteries.description: Jesus is born in Bethlehem
mysteries.scripture_text: 'She gave birth to her firstborn son and wrapped him in swaddling clothes.' (Luke 2:7)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for detachment from worldly goods and simplicity of life.

mysteries.title: The Presentation
mysteries.description: Mary and Joseph present Jesus in the Temple
mysteries.scripture_text: 'Now, Master, you may let your servant go in peace, according to your word.' (Luke 2:29)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for obedience to God's will and purification of our intentions.

mysteries.title: The Finding in the Temple
mysteries.description: Jesus is found teaching in the Temple at age twelve
mysteries.scripture_text: 'Did you not know that I must be in my Father's house?' (Luke 2:49)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for true wisdom and devotion to our duties and responsibilities.

mysteries.title: The Agony in the Garden
mysteries.description: Jesus prays in the Garden of Gethsemane
mysteries.scripture_text: 'Father, if you are willing, take this cup away from me; still, not my will but yours be done.' (Luke 22:42)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for contrition for our sins and resignation to God's will.

mysteries.title: The Scourging at the Pillar
mysteries.description: Jesus is cruelly scourged
mysteries.scripture_text: 'I gave my back to those who beat me.' (Isaiah 50:6)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for purity and self-mortification for love of Jesus.

mysteries.title: The Crowning with Thorns
mysteries.description: Jesus is mocked and crowned with thorns
mysteries.scripture_text: 'They clothed him in a purple cloak and weaved a crown of thorns.' (Mark 15:17)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for moral courage to live by Christian principles.

mysteries.title: The Carrying of the Cross
mysteries.description: Jesus carries the heavy cross to Calvary
mysteries.scripture_text: 'Take up your cross and follow me.' (Matthew 16:24)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for patience and perseverance in our daily trials.

mysteries.title: The Crucifixion
mysteries.description: Jesus dies on the cross for our salvation
mysteries.scripture_text: 'Father, forgive them for they know not what they do.' (Luke 23:34)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for the grace to forgive our enemies and the dying.

mysteries.title: The Resurrection
mysteries.description: Jesus rises victorious from the dead
mysteries.scripture_text: 'This is the day the Lord has made; let us be glad and rejoice in it.' (Psalm 118:24)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for faith in the resurrection of the body and life everlasting.

mysteries.title: The Ascension
mysteries.description: Jesus ascends into Heaven forty days after Easter
mysteries.scripture_text: 'All power in heaven and on earth has been given to me.' (Matthew 28:18)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for the grace to keep our hearts and minds raised to God.

mysteries.title: The Descent of the Holy Spirit
mysteries.description: The Holy Spirit comes upon Mary and the Apostles
mysteries.scripture_text: 'They were all filled with the Holy Spirit.' (Acts 2:4)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for the gifts and fruits of the Holy Spirit.

mysteries.title: The Assumption
mysteries.description: Mary is assumed body and soul into Heaven
mysteries.scripture_text: 'A great sign appeared in the sky, a woman clothed with the sun.' (Revelation 12:1)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for devotion to Mary and confidence in her intercession.

mysteries.title: The Coronation
mysteries.description: Mary is crowned Queen of Heaven
mysteries.scripture_text: 'A crown of twelve stars was on her head.' (Revelation 12:1)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for the grace to persevere and receive the crown of life.

mysteries.title: The Baptism of Christ
mysteries.description: Jesus is baptized by John the Baptist
mysteries.scripture_text: 'This is my beloved Son with whom I am well pleased.' (Matthew 3:17)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for the grace to live as beloved children of God.

mysteries.title: The Wedding at Cana
mysteries.description: Jesus performs His first miracle at Cana
mysteries.scripture_text: 'Do whatever he tells you.' (John 2:5)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for obedience to God's will even when it seems difficult.

mysteries.title: The Proclamation of the Kingdom
mysteries.description: Jesus proclaims the Kingdom of God
mysteries.scripture_text: 'The kingdom of God is at hand. Repent and believe in the gospel.' (Mark 1:15)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for detachment from worldly things and seeking God's kingdom first.

mysteries.title: The Transfiguration
mysteries.description: Jesus is transfigured before Peter, James, and John
mysteries.scripture_text: 'This is my beloved Son. Listen to him.' (Luke 9:35)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for the grace to recognize Christ's presence in our daily lives.

mysteries.title: The Institution of the Eucharist
mysteries.description: Jesus gives us the Eucharist at the Last Supper
mysteries.scripture_text: 'This is my body, which will be given for you.' (Luke 22:19)
mysteries.meditation_text: We pray for love and appreciation of the Holy Eucharist.
